title: In Munich, it's never too early for a breakfast beer with sausage and pretzels
description: Bavarians traditionally wash down a breakfast of boiled veal sausage, sweet mustard and a giant pretzel with beer — all before the church bells ring at midday.
text:
Bavarians traditionally wash down a breakfast of boiled veal sausage, sweet mustard and a giant pretzel with beer — all before the church bells ring at midday. Today is correspondent Esme Nicholson in the German city of Munich, sampling a Bavarian breakfast that's meat- and carb-heavy and not for the faint of heart. ESME NICHOLSON, (Speaking German).

DEMETRIOS KYRIAKIDES: (Speaking German). NICHOLSON: (Speaking German). He says the weiss beer, or wheat beer, helps wash down a breakfast of boiled veal sausages, sweet mustard and a giant pretzel.

KYRIAKIDES: (Speaking German). NICHOLSON: (Speaking German). NICHOLSON: Kyriakides, who prefers to be called Jimmy (ph), is as Bavarian as the breakfast.

NICHOLSON: (Speaking German).
